description:
## Why

Run the divergence harness on a schedule (or on PR) to surface regressions. Deferred per PKIX-7nsf parent bead until the divergence rate is known and the baseline is stable.

## What

1. GitHub Actions workflow (or whichever CI the project ends up on) that runs `pkix-difftest run pkits ... --output-json` and diffs against committed baseline.
2. Failure semantics: any new divergence (entry not in baseline) fails CI; oracles agreeing in a way that disagrees with baseline is also flagged.
3. Optional: scheduled (nightly) full pyca-corpus run, with results stored as build artefacts.

## Out of scope

- Live CT-log diff (very high volume; PKIX-5bab covers Tier 3 corpus first).
- pyca venv caching tuning (a follow-up if CI run time becomes a problem).

## Acceptance

- [ ] CI workflow file committed.
- [ ] Demonstrably catches a synthetic regression (intentionally introduced + reverted).
- [ ] Documentation in pkix-difftest/README.md updated to reference CI integration.

## Filed as

Follow-up to PKIX-7nsf, deferred per the parent bead's 'Recommended decomposition' step (10).
